rules.advice: Bound capacity to 65536 or less. Capacity is not length: fill an input-derived bounded slice before freeze/split/index consumers.

rules.advice: Compute the index/length from actual receiver.len(), not capacity. Preserve variation on valid inputs; prepare nonempty input-derived content where needed.

rules.advice: Preserve new(), then add grow(1 + decoded % 4096) before indexed consumers. Derive indices modulo actual len(). Adding grow/len helpers and consistent variable renaming is allowed; returning on every input is not repair.
Map bytes to a valid supported year/month/day; use month length and leap-year rules or explicitly document a restricted day range. Preserve meaningful input variation including multi-byte inputs.

rules.advice: Ensure Result-producing date constructors have successful valid inputs before downstream calls. Account for leap years; keep the target call and extraction, not unconditional early return.
